fields.q0: Sometimes things happen to people that are unusually or especially frightening, horrible, or traumatic. For example: • a serious accident or fire • a physical or sexual assault or abuse • an earthquake or flood • a war • seeing someone be killed or seriously injured • having a loved one die through homicide or suicide. Have you ever experienced this kind of event?
fields.q1: had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
fields.q2: tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
fields.q3: been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
fields.q4: felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
fields.q5: felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?
